statement: In the cited primary source, nontriviality of the 3D nearest-neighbor Ising model means that the signed renormalized coupling g(beta)=sum U4(0,x,y,z)/(chi(beta)^2 xi(beta)^3) does not tend to zero as beta increases to beta_c; U4<=0.

statement: For beta<beta_c, let B={y:||y||_infinity<=floor(xi)} and draw (X,Y,Z) with joint mass P(X=x,Y=y,Z=z)=G(x)G(z-y)/(|B|chi^2) for y in B. Thus X is independent of (Y,Z). Let q_beta be the expected probability that two independent currents with respective source pairs (0,X) and (Y,Z) connect all four marked vertices in their union. Then -g(beta)>=2|B|q_beta/xi^3. If xi->infinity and liminf q_beta>0, C0052 follows in the source's coupling sense.
assumptions: The stated full joint endpoint mass; subcritical infinite-volume current identity of Exercise 61(1) and convergence of its finite-volume version; nearest-neighbor zero-field Ising on Z^3; xi>0, chi<infinity.
source_quote: U4(x1,...,x4) = -2 <sigma1 sigma2><sigma3 sigma4> P[all connected] (formula paraphrase).
proof_or_counterexample: Sum the nonnegative identity over x,z in Z^3 and y in B. By the specified sampling law the partial sum equals 2|B|chi^2 q_beta. Divide by chi^2 xi^3 and note |B|/xi^3 tends to 8.

remaining_gap: Prove a scale-uniform lower bound for q_beta and justify the assumed infinite-volume passage. Parent problem remains unsolved.

statement: On degree-three ferromagnetic trees T_{H,m} formed by a depth-H binary bush and length-m handle at equal edge parameter log 3, sample endpoint X with law G(o,x)/chi and one current with sources o triangle X. Its bare hit probability k(v) at the handle tip satisfies k(v)/G(o,v)->0 along H=m^2 as m->infinity. Hence no graph-uniform positive linear lower bound k>=c G follows merely from endpoint averaging; this says nothing against a Z^3-specific bound.
assumptions: Finite zero-field free-boundary Ising trees, maximum degree three, all edge parameters log 3; current parity factorization on trees; X weighted by G/chi.
source: owner-own-work: ~/brain_workers/w470/ENDPOINT_TREE_OBSTRUCTION.md; current identity background Aizenman arXiv:2112.04248v2 (5.9)
proof_or_counterexample: Tree spin correlation gives tau=4/5 per edge; an even current edge is present with rho=2/5. With S_H=sum_h(2tau)^h and T_m=sum_j tau^j, exact k(v)=[S_H rho^m+sum_j tau^j rho^(m-j)]/[S_H+T_m]. For H=m^2, k(v)/tau^m <=2^(-m)+4(5/8)^(m^2)(5/4)^m ->0.
remaining_gap: Independent referee check; no implication for the homogeneous critical Z^3 model or C0052.
